name: Karpathy-Inspired Claude Code Guidelines
summary: A CLAUDE.md rule set that makes coding agents state assumptions, keep changes surgical and loop on verifiable success criteria.
description: One guidelines file distilled from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls, shipped as a Claude Code plugin, a per-project CLAUDE.md and a committed Cursor project rule. Four principles — think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, goal-driven execution — each with concrete rules and tests for knowing they are working.
contains: four principles in one CLAUDE.md file
